content.question: What does the maximum matching algorithm do in tokenization?
options: It selects the most frequent word in the corpus as a token boundary
It greedily extracts the longest dictionary word starting at each position, used for languages written without spaces
It matches each token to its part-of-speech tag
It finds the longest sentence in a document
content.answer: It greedily extracts the longest dictionary word starting at each position, used for languages written without spaces
